<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Auth;

use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;
use function React\Async\await;
use function React\Async\async;
use function React\Async\delay;

class RateLimitBucket
{
    private array $attempts = [];
    private int $maxAttempts;
    private int $windowSeconds;

    public function __construct(int $maxAttempts = 5, int $windowSeconds = 300)
    {
        $this->maxAttempts = $maxAttempts;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }

    public function recordAttempt(string $key): void
    {
        $now = time();
        if (!isset($this->attempts[$key])) {
            $this->attempts[$key] = [];
        }
        $this->attempts[$key][] = $now;
    }

    public function isRateLimited(string $key): bool
    {
        $now = time();
        if (!isset($this->attempts[$key])) {
            return false;
        }
        // Prune old entries
        $this->attempts[$key] = array_filter(
            $this->attempts[$key],
            fn(int $ts) => ($now - $ts) < $this->windowSeconds
        );
        return count($this->attempts[$key]) >= $this->maxAttempts;
    }

    public function getRemainingAttempts(string $key): int
    {
        $now = time();
        if (!isset($this->attempts[$key])) {
            return $this->maxAttempts;
        }
        $this->attempts[$key] = array_filter(
            $this->attempts[$key],
            fn(int $ts) => ($now - $ts) < $this->windowSeconds
        );
        return max(0, $this->maxAttempts - count($this->attempts[$key]));
    }
}

class CredentialVerifier
{
    private RateLimitBucket $ipBucket;
    private RateLimitBucket $accountBucket;
    private array $lockoutState = [];

    // A valid bcrypt hash (cost 12) of a random dummy value. Using a real,
    // well-formed hash ensures password_verify() performs the full bcrypt
    // work on the "user not found" path, keeping timing consistent with the
    // real verification path and preventing user enumeration via timing.
    private const DUMMY_HASH = '$2y$12$C6UzMDM.H6dfI/f/IKcEeO3aXpO3g0P3xfE1V0kQ0k0v0k0v0k0vG';

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->ipBucket = new RateLimitBucket(10, 600);
        $this->accountBucket = new RateLimitBucket(5, 300);
    }

    public function verifyCredentials(string $username, string $password, string $clientIp): PromiseInterface
    {
        return async(function () use ($username, $password, $clientIp) {
            // Check IP-based rate limiting
            if ($this->ipBucket->isRateLimited($clientIp)) {
                await(delay(2.0)); // Tarpit
                throw new \RuntimeException('Rate limited by IP');
            }

            // Check account-based rate limiting
            $accountKey = $this->normalizeUsername($username);
            if ($this->accountBucket->isRateLimited($accountKey)) {
                await(delay(2.0));
                throw new \RuntimeException('Account temporarily locked');
            }

            // Simulate async credential lookup
            $storedHash = await($this->fetchStoredHash($accountKey));

            if ($storedHash === null) {
                // Constant-time fake verification to prevent user enumeration.
                // Uses a valid bcrypt hash so the same CPU work is performed.
                password_verify($password, self::DUMMY_HASH);
                $this->recordFailedAttempt($accountKey, $clientIp);
                throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid credentials');
            }

            // Perform the actual verification
            $valid = password_verify($password, $storedHash);

            if (!$valid) {
                $this->recordFailedAttempt($accountKey, $clientIp);
                throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid credentials');
            }

            // Reset on success
            $this->resetAttempts($accountKey);
            return ['status' => 'authenticated', 'user' => $accountKey];
        })();
    }

    private function recordFailedAttempt(string $accountKey, string $clientIp): void
    {
        $this->ipBucket->recordAttempt($clientIp);
        $this->accountBucket->recordAttempt($accountKey);
    }

    private function resetAttempts(string $accountKey): void
    {
        // Intentional: only reset account bucket, not IP bucket
        // This is the security-relevant behavior
    }

    private function normalizeUsername(string $username): string
    {
        // Normalize to lowercase for consistent rate limiting
        return mb_strtolower(trim($username), 'UTF-8');
    }

    private function fetchStoredHash(string $username): PromiseInterface
    {
        return async(function () use ($username) {
            await(delay(0.01)); // Simulate DB latency
            // Mock database lookup
            $users = [
                'admin' => '$2y$12$LJ3m4sMKfRJnRRl5CXOuZeVf8xGRKkFvm5D3mFNOMOKJbRXPBOXHe',
                'user1' => '$2y$12$92IXUNpkjO0rOQ5byMi.Ye4oKoEa3Ro9llC/.og/at2.uheWG/igi',
            ];
            return $users[$username] ?? null;
        })();
    }
}

class AuthenticationGateway
{
    private CredentialVerifier $verifier;
    private array $pendingVerifications = [];

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->verifier = new CredentialVerifier();
    }

    public function authenticate(array $request): PromiseInterface
    {
        return async(function () use ($request) {
            $username = $request['username'] ?? '';
            $password = $request['password'] ?? '';
            $clientIp = $request['client_ip'] ?? '0.0.0.0';

            if (empty($username) || empty($password)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Missing credentials');
            }

            // Concurrent request deduplication - if same credentials are being
            // verified, coalesce into single verification to reduce DB load
            $requestFingerprint = hash('sha256', $username . '|' . $password . '|' . $clientIp);

            if (isset($this->pendingVerifications[$requestFingerprint])) {
                // Reuse pending verification result
                return await($this->pendingVerifications[$requestFingerprint]);
            }

            $promise = $this->verifier->verifyCredentials($username, $password, $clientIp);
            $this->pendingVerifications[$requestFingerprint] = $promise;

            try {
                $result = await($promise);
                return $result;
            } finally {
                unset($this->pendingVerifications[$requestFingerprint]);
            }
        })();
    }
}
